Do not expose the harness
port to a network.

picker can inspect the"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" design DOM. A mockup’s HTML/JS is therefore executable
code with same-origin access; only open desi"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"gns you trust.
- `asset_import` accepts local source paths. Treat the Studio API as equivalent
to lo"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"cal file access.
- Freeze is a tool/context guard, not an OS ACL. Direct file writes are outside
its"},{"id":"p15s6","text":" control.

the request carries `prompt`, `par"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ent`, `cwd`, `signal` and `maxDepth`. The old
`.start(provider, { persona, … })` call silently faile"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"d on 0.2.x.

`session"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"s` service no longer exists; orphan detection reads `ctx.agents.list()`.

`dsh.client.inject` now names `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversatio"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"n`,
`…-ui-settings`, `…-ui-session` and `…-locale`; `immediately: true` makes the tab
register at bo"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"ot. The removed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` entry is gone.
4. **`conversation.view` hands `ses"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"sionId` as a standard prop.** The obsolete
registration `inject: (sessionId) => ({ sessionId })` fac"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"e was removed; the view
reads `props.sessionId` directly.
5. **Send to the main chat through `Sessio"},{"id":"p18s12","text":"nFace.prompt`.** The scoped
`conversation.send` path is gone; the tab uses
`sessions.binding(id).ses"},{"id":"p18s13","text":"sion.prompt([{ type: 'text', text }], 'queue')`.
6. **No shell assumptions.** The host builds shell "},{"id":"p18s14","text":"semantics itself only where it
still needs the subprocess seam (Node helper for binary writes/delete"},{"id":"p18s15","text":"s, OS file
manager for reveal). ZIP export is a built-in store-only writer. This is what makes
the p"},{"id":"p18s16","text":"lugin work on Windows.
7. **Commit `lib/`.** A harness checkout's `.gitignore` ignores `lib/` — a pl"},{"id":"p18s17","text":"ugin
committed inside one ships without its entry point. This repo lives at its own top
level and sh"},{"id":"p18s18","text":"ips plain JS, so `lib/index.js` is committed.
8. **Hard-inject host services you register against.**"},{"id":"p18s19","text":" `apply()` runs as soon as its
